tickets.name: Refuse unsafe smoke publication destinations before deleting any files

criteria.requirement: Tests using disposable sentinels reject checkout roots, source projects, filesystem/home roots, OUT itself, ancestors/descendants that would delete active evidence, and symlink aliases to those targets.
criteria.assessment: Protected ancestors/descendants and symlink path components are checked before smoke starts.

criteria.requirement: An existing unowned nonempty destination is refused with exit 4 before pytest or any deletion; all sentinels remain byte-identical.
criteria.assessment: Truthy non-object ownership JSON currently raises AttributeError instead of Refusal(code=4). Patch adds a type guard; 26 publication cases passed in an isolated worktree, but patch is not in frozen primary.

criteria.requirement: A failed test run cannot delete an existing publication.
criteria.assessment: Failed pytest does not enter publication staging. Smoke itself now creates a fresh invocation directory rather than deleting prior files.

criteria.requirement: Fresh publication and a clearly defined owned-directory refresh still work; interruption cannot expose a half-replaced successful publication.
criteria.assessment: Fresh/empty or intact same-kind bundles activate by rename or Linux rename exchange under parent-directory flock. Interruption before activation preserves prior bundle.

closure_notes: Final frozen suite has not completed.
Apply and verify ownership-shape refusal patch.

tickets.name: Make the corpus regression gate fail on lost validation and missing evidence

criteria.requirement: A valid baseline followed by process PASS / validation FAIL / routing NOT_RUN / missing DRC and preservation evidence fails corpus check and after_update.
criteria.assessment: The exact process-PASS/validation-FAIL/routing-NOT_RUN case fails both check and after_update.

criteria.requirement: Validation PASS to FAIL fails even when all numeric counts are unchanged.
criteria.assessment: PASS-to-FAIL status transition is independent of numeric counters.

criteria.requirement: COMPLETE to INCOMPLETE fails even if pair evidence changes without increasing unconnected_in_scope.
criteria.assessment: COMPLETE-to-INCOMPLETE fails with unchanged open count.

criteria.requirement: Removal of a required preservation check or counter is reported as missing evidence, not an improvement.
criteria.assessment: Preservation check inventory and known nonnegative counters cannot disappear silently.

criteria.requirement: Unchanged valid runs pass; legitimate improvements remain reported; existing refusal and incomplete-baseline behavior is tested explicitly.
criteria.assessment: Valid, deliberately incomplete, invalid-validation and refusal cases have explicit comparisons. Existing unconditional process-failure policy is unchanged.

criteria.assessment: Distinct pre_refill_board_sha256 remains equal to validation.delivered_board_sha256 and differs from final candidate digest in retained changed-refill records.

criteria.requirement: Determinism's candidate_bytes layer compares post-refill delivered artifacts; backend-output comparison remains independent.
criteria.assessment: candidate_bytes uses validation final digest or explicitly marked post-refill evidence. Backend-output comparison remains separate.

criteria.requirement: Both route schemas and revalidation receipts retain explicit compatibility behavior, with tests for unchanged and changed refills.
criteria.assessment: Both schemas and shared route/revalidation evidence describe basis and legacy compatibility. Four changed/unchanged x initial/revalidation unit cases also resolve every receipt locator.

tickets.name: Key baseline DRC caches by grading identity and publish complete cache entries

criteria.requirement: Unchanged input and grader hit the cache; changing the selected board, kicad-cli identity or grading schema causes a miss.
criteria.assessment: Key includes selected board, native identities and grader/schema content; existing input/grader hits and changed dimensions miss.

criteria.requirement: No old-tool baseline is silently reused after a tool change; the result identifies the actual baseline generation.
criteria.assessment: Retained measured candidate identifies cache generation and identity. Generation payload hashes and actual identity were verified from disk.

criteria.requirement: Concurrent writers/readers and interruption between each cache write cannot yield a mixed-generation hit.
criteria.assessment: Unique immutable generation directories plus atomic current.json selection; readers verify all payload hashes and structure.

criteria.requirement: Missing or malformed report/info/pour evidence triggers safe recomputation without modifying the source project.
criteria.assessment: Missing/malformed report, info, pour, receipt or pointer recomputes; pointer path escapes miss; source bytes remain unchanged.

criteria.requirement: Changing source bytes, compiled extension bytes or the relevant dependency environment permits a new attempt despite unchanged semantic versions.
criteria.assessment: Source/module/dependency content changes permit a new attempt; execution identity is recorded in result.backend.

criteria.requirement: An unrelated documentation commit does not change the engine identity.
criteria.assessment: Changing informational repository commit does not alter new execution identity/fingerprint.

criteria.requirement: Installed packages without Git metadata still get distinct content-based identities.
criteria.assessment: Actual fake installed source/module/METADATA byte changes remain distinguishable with Git unavailable.

criteria.requirement: An actually identical failed attempt is refused; --force and old-row handling remain deterministic.
criteria.assessment: Identical failures refuse, --force remains explicit, and historical rows/results retain deterministic legacy identity reconstruction.

criteria.requirement: Fingerprint reconstruction from result.json agrees with the stored ledger fingerprint, including protect-human settings.
criteria.assessment: Human designation is resolved before fingerprinting and its key hash is stored. Earlier native human test passed; current retained normal-run fingerprints reconstruct, with final frozen human case pending live full suite.

tickets.name: Publish self-verifiable receipt bundles without stale files or destination-symlink writes

criteria.requirement: A verifier can resolve and hash every included evidence record using only the publication directory.
criteria.assessment: Manifest maps original locators to included paths and hashes; verifier needs only publication directory.

criteria.requirement: Excluded board/input artifacts are explicitly external, not presented as included or verifiable from the bundle.
criteria.assessment: Boards/input/rules/backend output are explicitly external, and private work/log/board directories are excluded.

criteria.requirement: Publishing twice, or publishing a new run with fewer receipts, cannot retain misleading stale evidence.
criteria.assessment: Every publication is built fresh, so fewer receipts cannot leave obsolete files.

criteria.requirement: Destination file/directory symlink sentinels outside the publication remain untouched.
criteria.assessment: Destination symlink paths and contents are refused before writing; aliased source directories/receipts are skipped.

criteria.requirement: The original run and its signed/hashed receipt bytes remain unchanged; layout/schema changes have a documented compatibility path.
criteria.assessment: Original result bytes are preserved; manifest is an additive compatibility path for legacy flat locators. Old unmarked destinations require archive or a fresh destination.

tickets.name: Strengthen the router benchmark's quality gate and resource measurements

criteria.requirement: A failed warmup, missing quality evidence, routing COMPLETE-to-INCOMPLETE transition, failed pair, or wall-clock-censored sample cannot produce a clean qualification.
criteria.assessment: Warmups and measured attempts must supply valid process/routing/native/preservation/pair/stop evidence. Missing command evidence yields unknown stop status and rejects.

criteria.requirement: Migration-equivalence mode fails changed copper geometry; an intentional algorithm-change mode documents its independent acceptance criteria.
criteria.assessment: Migration requires copper equivalence; algorithm-change still requires independent native, preservation, pair and connection acceptance.

criteria.requirement: At least three measured repetitions, separate warmup, raw samples and tool/input identities remain recorded per board; time and memory limits stay at 1.10 unless the owner changes them.
criteria.assessment: Retained multipoint receipt has three measured samples per side plus separate warmups, input/tool identities and 1.10 gates. Live five-sample matrix is not treated as complete.

criteria.requirement: The report distinguishes legacy GNU-time RSS from concurrent process-tree peak memory and states which metric each gate enforces.
criteria.assessment: GNU-time RSS and sampled simultaneous descendant RSS are separate gated metrics. Current sampler records actual maximum intervals and documents lower-bound/shared-page limitations.

criteria.requirement: Include an authorized dense/multipoint/rescue workload or a sanitized representative fixture, preserving native correctness and no-rule-relaxation checks.
criteria.assessment: Sanitized Git-pinned multipoint/rescue fixture is qualified in retained receipt. Deterministic public twelve-net/three-multipoint dense generator and generated input are also present; no dense/rescue speedup claim is made.

criteria.requirement: Unit cases exercise exactly 1.10, above-limit ratios, absent/invalid metrics and every quality rejection without running real benchmarks.
criteria.assessment: Tests cover exact 1.10, over-limit, absent/invalid metrics and all named quality rejection paths without real benchmark execution.

baseline_cache.logical_identity: SHA256 of canonical JSON cache identity; independent unique generations for each construction.
fields: grading content hashes: baselinecache.py, cli.py, pour.py, kicad/pour.py, contract.py
baseline_cache.conflicts: Concurrent same-key builders use disjoint directories; last complete atomic current.json publication wins. Readers snapshot that pointer and verify DRC/info/pour hashes plus generation identity. Legacy or incomplete entries miss. Previously referenced generations remain intact.

run_ledger.logical_attempt_identity: SHA256(input fingerprint + backend name + normalized settings). None settings and empty backend_env are omitted; net_patterns/netclasses sorted; backend_args retain order.
run_ledger.informational_provenance_excluded: Repository commit is preserved separately but removed from new execution identity.
run_ledger.conflicts: Any existing identical failed fingerprint refuses unless --force or explicit ledger-off. Different execution fingerprint permits new attempt and records changed-build note. Ledger append is not an execution lock or exactly-once guarantee.
run_ledger.scope_limit: Native grader and wrapper identities are separately recorded in baseline/tool evidence; this ticket changes backend execution identity, not the repeat-refusal policy.

repeat_proof.conflicts: All repeated executed builds must agree; record checks active build and drift under shared reentrant update_lock. refresh and record_determinism serialize with activation.

publication.logical_identity: Absolute non-symlink destination path plus manifest schema/kind and exact included-path/hash inventory.
publication.conflicts: Fresh/empty destination or intact same-kind owned inventory accepted; differing kind, changed inventory, symlinks or overlapping protected paths refuse. Parent-directory flock serializes cooperating replacement; atomic rename exchange retains the previous bundle until activation. Non-object ownership shape currently needs pending patch.

corpus.predicate: Sorted immediate root/*/entry.json paths; successful truthy JSON values become entries. --name filters loaded entries and explicitly missing names fail. No independent authoritative expected-entry registry exists.
corpus.residual: Invalid JSON/falsey entry contents can disappear from unnamed discovery; after_update skips an empty discovered corpus. This catalog risk is outside ticket69 exact per-outcome comparison acceptance. No claim that all owner boards or an external custom KICAD_ROUTE_CORPUS were exercised.

publication.predicate: Non-symlink immediate *.json and RESULT.md from run root, validate/, facts/, spokes/; then the latest lexically sorted non-symlink 2* directory under each revalidate/ and revalidate-origin/. Symlink files and aliased directories excluded. Private candidate/reference/work trees and logs excluded.
publication.collision_policy: Run-root receipt wins normal flat name; conflicting validate receipt nests under validate/. Source publication.json moves under receipts/. Revalidation copies keep distinct names.
publication.scope: Population is explicitly this receipt contract; no whole-run or whole-directory completeness claim.
